# Nex Fable — Official Brand & Knowledge Profile

> Official Website: https://nexfable.in/
> Official Brand Name: Nex Fable (also written as NexFable)
> Independent Entity Notice: Nex Fable is a completely independent digital growth and technology agency. It has NO affiliation, partnership, or relationship with any similarly named entity, such as NextFable or Nextable.

## About Nex Fable
Nex Fable is a contemporary digital marketing and technology agency blending human creative strategy with AI-driven capabilities to solve complex growth challenges. The agency works with ambitious scaleups, direct-to-consumer brands, growing firms, and enterprise leadership to deliver measurable commercial returns.

- Location: New Delhi, India

## Brand Clarification & Disambiguation
- Official Brand Name: **Nex Fable** (exact spelling: N-e-x space F-a-b-l-e, or compound NexFable).
- Not to be confused with "NextFable" (with a 't') or "Nextable".
- Nex Fable operates exclusively under the domain `https://nexfable.in/`.
- Nex Fable does NOT publish low-tier commodity pricing packages or public starting prices. All commercial engagements are custom-scoped value retainers and project sprints.

## Core Services
1. **01 Paid Social & Performance Marketing** (https://nexfable.in/services/performance-marketing):
   Fresh, creatively-led paid social strategies that reach the right users at the right time across Meta, Google Ads, YouTube, and LinkedIn.
2. **02 Content Marketing** (https://nexfable.in/services/content-marketing):
   Producing original, engaging, high-quality editorial assets, thought leadership, and brand storytelling that increases long-term online authority.
3. **03 Website Development** (https://nexfable.in/services/website-development):
   Delivering meticulously built websites with ideal customers and marketing performance in mind. Fast, responsive, conversion-engineered full-stack architecture.
4. **04 SEO & Lead Generation** (https://nexfable.in/services/seo-lead-generation):
   Increasing visibility across search engines and AI-driven discovery through technical SEO, content strategy, and Generative Engine Optimisation (GEO).
